content.user_title: Build Microsoft Entra Authentication Event Functions
content.value_statement: Custom authentication extensions require precise event contracts and response actions. This skill provides focused .NET patterns for Azure Functions and Microsoft Entra events.
actual_capabilities: Creates token issuance handlers that add custom claims to Microsoft Entra tokens.
Shows attribute collection start handlers with default, prefill, and blocking responses.
Builds attribute submission validation and value modification workflows.
Outlines custom OTP delivery handlers with success and failure responses.
Provides Function App configuration, Entra registration steps, and SDK type references.
limitations: Provides guidance and examples but does not deploy or configure Azure resources automatically.
Uses placeholder external API and SMS integrations that require production implementations.
Does not replace tenant-specific permission, security, timeout, or compliance testing.
Focuses on the Azure WebJobs Authentication Events extension and not every Microsoft identity SDK.

use_cases.title: Enrich issued tokens
use_cases.description: Design a token issuance function that retrieves trusted profile data and returns approved custom claims.

use_cases.title: Validate sign-up attributes
use_cases.description: Create attribute collection handlers that prefill values, reject invalid submissions, and normalize accepted data.

use_cases.title: Plan custom OTP delivery
use_cases.description: Structure an OTP event handler for an approved SMS, email, or push provider.

prompt_templates.title: Create a token claims handler
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a .NET Azure Function for OnTokenIssuanceStart. Add department and cost center claims from trusted input. Include validation and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Validate sign-up attributes
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an OnAttributeCollectionSubmit handler. Validate email and display name, return field errors, and normalize accepted values.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate an external profile service
prompt_templates.prompt: Design token enrichment using an external profile API. Include authentication, timeouts, caching, response validation, fallback behavior, and privacy-safe logging.

prompt_templates.title: Review a production authentication extension
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Entra authentication event design for security, latency, failure behavior, permissions, claims integrity, observability, and deployment readiness.

output_examples.input: Create a token issuance handler that adds department and employee identifier claims.
output: Handler outline for the token issuance event
Checks for a valid user identifier before lookup
Returns only approved department and employee identifier claims
Uses a continuation response when enrichment fails

output_examples.input: Review an attribute collection handler for production readiness.
output: Validation gaps for missing and malformed attributes
Logging changes that protect personal data
Tests for valid, invalid, missing, and provider-failure cases

output_examples.input: Plan a custom OTP delivery integration.
output_examples.output: A delivery workflow covering provider authentication, timeout handling, protected logs, success responses, failure responses, and retry boundaries.

best_practices: Validate event payloads and external data before adding claims or modifying user attributes.
Use managed identities, narrow permissions, strict timeouts, and explicit fallback behavior for dependencies.
Log correlation identifiers while excluding OTP values, tokens, phone numbers, and unnecessary personal data.
anti_patterns: Do not trust external profile fields or place unrestricted data into token claims.
Do not throw unhandled exceptions that can interrupt the authentication flow.
Do not place secrets, OTP values, access tokens, or personal identifiers in logs.

faq.question: Which Microsoft Entra events does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers token issuance start, attribute collection start, attribute collection submit, and custom OTP send events.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy an Azure Function?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation and configuration guidance, while deployment remains environment-specific.

faq.question: Can it connect token enrichment to an external API?
faq.answer: Yes. It outlines the pattern, but you must add secure authentication, validation, timeouts, caching, and production error handling.

faq.question: Does it include a working SMS provider integration?
faq.answer: No. The OTP example contains a placeholder method that must be connected to an approved provider.

faq.question: Is the skill limited to in-process Azure Functions?
faq.answer: It includes WebJobs trigger examples and a brief isolated worker configuration example. Confirm model compatibility with your selected package version.

faq.question: What should be tested before production use?
faq.answer: Test payload validation, claim integrity, permissions, dependency failures, timeout behavior, privacy-safe logging, and every authentication fallback path.
